spans.s:
Powder,Ⓒs.ⒹcUrRaM, pizwaM, kzodaH; ‘gun-p(owder)’ AgneyacUrRaM; ‘perfumed p(owder)’ vAsayogaH, pizwAtaH-takaH, pawavAsakaH.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓ‘to reduce to p(owder)’ cUrR 10, kzud 7 P, cUrRIkf, piz 7 P; See Poond.
Ⓑ
 2 cUrRena lip 6 P, or BU c. or miSr 10.
Ⓝ[Powder]y,Ⓒa.ⒹpAMSula, cUrRavat, cUrRamaya (yI f.), sacUrRa, sakzoda.

Power,Ⓒs.ⒹSakti f., sAmarTyaM, balaM, praBAvaH, vIryaM, UrjaH, sahas-ojas n., viBavaH (vAgviBavaH); (martial) tejas n., vi-parA-kramaH, SOryaM.
Ⓑ
 2 (Ability) SaktiH, kzamatA, DISaktiH; ‘p(ower) or thinking’ vicAraRA-SaktiH; ‘according to oneʼs p(ower)’ yaTA-Sakti-balaM, yAvacCakyaM.
Ⓑ
 3 (Influence) praButvaM, praBAvaH, vaSaH-SaM, balaM, gOravaM, aDi-kAraH; ADipatyaM, ISatvaM, sattA, ESvaryaM, aDInatA.
Ⓑ
 4 aDipaH-patiH, aDISaH, praBuH.
Ⓑ
 5 (Legal) aDikAraH, or by arh 1 P.
Ⓑ
 6 aDikArijanaH, aDikftaH.
Ⓑ
 7 GAtaH.
Ⓑ
 8 senA, balaM, pftanA; ‘have or exercise p(ower) over’ praBU 1 P, IS 2 A (with gen.), vaSIkf, AyattIkf, AtmavaSaM nI 1 P; ‘in (under) the p(ossible) of’ vaSa, aDIna, Ayatta, taMtra in comp.; ‘fallen into anotherʼs p(ower)’ para hastagata; ‘to be in oneʼs p(ower)’ ex. by Sak 5 P or by (s.).
Ⓝ[Power]ful,Ⓒa.Ⓓbala-sAmarTya-vat, Sakta, balin, sabala, prabala, Urja-svala, ojasvin, Saktimat, Urjitasattva, balAQya, sapraBAva, praBavizRu.
Ⓑ
 2 SUra, vIra, vikrAMta, tejasvin, mahApratApa, pratApavat, DA-mavat, uruvikrama.
Ⓑ
 3 (Medicine) vIryavat, amoGa, guRAvaha, prabala, alaMtama.
Ⓑ
 4 dfQa, pratItikArin, prabala.
Ⓝ[Power]fully,Ⓒadv.Ⓓbalavat, prabalaM, sapraBAvaM, atyaMtaM.
Ⓝ[Power]fulness,Ⓒs.ⒹprA-balyaM, SaktatvaM.
Ⓝ[Power]less,Ⓒa.Ⓓnirbala, SaktihIna, aSakta, abala, nizpraBAva, asamarTa, akzama.
Ⓝ[Power]lessness,Ⓒs.ⒹaSakti f., asAmarTya.
